Screen 2 of 7, split out of AS-45 by that task's own PRE-AGREED SPLIT TRIGGER (plan §8), fired on measurement rather than on judgement: at the moment screen 1 was complete and green, `git diff --stat master...feat/AS-45-onboarding-ui` reported 1,505 insertions and 244 deletions — 1,749 changed lines against a 900-line stop line, and over 900 on insertions alone. The plan set that line in advance precisely so it would not be decided under pressure, and instructed the implementer to stop, land screen 1, and file this task. The seam is the plan's own: "the view layer + screen 1" against "screen 2" — not screen 1 vs screen 2, because they share the stylesheet and the entire mechanism.

WHAT AS-45 ALREADY LANDED, and this task inherits rather than re-derives: the view layer (`apps/invoicing/README.md` § The view layer is the artifact to read first). Three escaping properties as concept rows in test/dependency-policy.test.js, each on a measured-zero baseline — no raw-output tag (gated by a keyed, counted, line-pinned allowlist that is currently EMPTY), no interpolation in an href/src/action/formaction/style attribute, no event-handler attribute, no script or style element, and double-quoted attribute values. The strengthened token check in test/assets.test.js ('every visual value in public/ CSS traces to a token that exists'), which resolves every var(--name) against the vendored tokens.css and enforces the @media breakpoint carve-out against the token's actual value. public/app.css, complete for BOTH screens — its banner-success and banner-warning rules are already there and unused, so this task adds markup, not styling (re-measure APP_CSS_DECLARATIONS and APP_CSS_VAR_REFERENCES in test/assets.test.js if it does change). The view-model/template split, lib/screens/<screen>-view.js plus a presentation-only template stamping data-state on its root element. test/screens.test.js, whose screen-1 half is the shape to follow.

SCOPE. `GET /connect-stripe` in `connectRoutes` (routes/connect.js), below the auth boundary — protected by position alone, adding no third publicness mechanism. Create apps/invoicing/views/connect-stripe.ejs and apps/invoicing/lib/screens/connect-view.js; add screen 2's half to test/screens.test.js; add its row to lib/views.js's VIEWS (with health.test.js's two literals, currently 1 and ['signin.ejs']); add 'GET /connect-stripe' to test/auth.test.js's ALL_ROUTES, G2's protected list, and the four cardinality literals (currently 17 / 16 / 11 / 17); recount test/dependency-policy.test.js's app-source list and its cardinality (currently 50). NO CHANGE to the three existing connect handlers, their statuses, or their bodies. test/connect.test.js is NOT MODIFIED AT ALL — if a change to it becomes necessary the scope boundary has been crossed and the task stops.

--- AS-45 plan §3.5.2, verbatim ---

Screen 2 — a pure function of the stored row.

`GET /connect-stripe` reads `repos.connectedAccounts.getByFreelancer(actingFreelancerId(req))` and renders. It makes no Stripe call. AS-41's rule is that readiness is written only from a snapshot freshly obtained by the request that writes it — creation and return are the sync moments; a page view is not one. (A Stripe call from a route would also fail the 'platform Stripe call' concept row, which pins `platform: true` to lib/connect/onboarding.js.)

The mapping is total over the row: `null` (no connected account) renders S2-DEFAULT-NOTSTARTED; `row.ready === true` renders S2-RETURN-READY; `row.ready === false` renders S2-RETURN-NOTREADY. `ready` is `chargesEnabled && requirementsCurrentlyDue.length === 0`, derived in exactly one place (lib/db/repositories/connected-accounts.js's mapper). The screen reads the boolean and does not re-derive it — that is the same "one place" rule AS-41 wrote it for.

The S2-ABANDON divergence, stated plainly. The ledger says S2-ABANDON "renders S2-DEFAULT-NOTSTARTED again — we were never told anything changed." That was written assuming no row exists until Stripe redirects back. AS-41 creates the row at start, before the first account link is minted. So after a genuine abandonment a row exists and is not ready, and the honest render is S2-RETURN-NOTREADY — "Stripe still needs more information; finish setup" — whose button posts to the same POST /connect-stripe/start, which Stripe resumes at the freelancer's own last point, exactly as the ledger's prose describes. Telling a freelancer with a half-built Stripe account "Connect your Stripe account" as if nothing had happened would be the less accurate of the two.

The alternative — distinguishing "arrived via Stripe's return" from "wandered back" — requires a marker on the redirect, and any marker in a URL is client-supplied, so a freelancer could produce either state at will. Rejected: the screen renders the row, and how the visitor arrived is not a state it may read. S2-ABANDON is therefore a reachability path into one of the three row-derived renders, not a fourth render. Proposed ledger amendment wording in AS-45 plan §9 Q3 — route it to Jonah (agent:ux-jonah) as a documentation follow-up; do not edit docs/design/** from this task.

Screen 2's ledger, all nine rows, partitioned: S2-DEFAULT-NOTSTARTED (signed in, no connected_accounts row) rendered; S2-RETURN-READY (row seeded chargesEnabled: true, requirementsCurrentlyDue: []) rendered; S2-RETURN-NOTREADY (row seeded chargesEnabled: false AND separately chargesEnabled: true with a non-empty requirementsCurrentlyDue — both halves of `ready`) rendered; S2-ERROR-SYSTEM (GET /connect-stripe?error=start, the documented URL) rendered — 4. S2-DENIED-SIGNEDOUT (cookieless GET /connect-stripe -> guard 303 /signin?next=%2Fconnect-stripe) and S2-REFRESH (GET /connect-stripe/refresh -> 303 into a fresh Stripe link; its own content is never seen) redirect-answered — 2. S2-ABANDON, a path into a render — 1. S2-LOADING, unrenderable — 1. S2-EMPTY, n/a — 1. 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9. The test asserts that arithmetic against a committed table, so a row appearing or vanishing in 02-states-ledger.md §2 turns it red.

--- AS-45 plan §3.5.3, verbatim ---

S2-ERROR-SYSTEM and the gap this task does not close.

The wireframe wants an error banner and a "Try again" control on screen 2 when the account-link call fails. Today POST /connect-stripe/start answers that with 502 text/plain "StripeApiError: mint-onboarding-link".

Making the POST redirect into the screen means changing routes/connect.js's failure landing, which test/connect.test.js pins by status at four places. That is another task's committed assertions and another task's stated decision ("error bodies are one-line text/plain; screens render states from the DB row, not from these bodies").

Decision: render the state, do not rewire the POST. `GET /connect-stripe?error=start` renders S2-ERROR-SYSTEM — a documented URL, which the VERIFICATION clause explicitly admits as a reachability mechanism. The parameter is treated as a presence flag selecting a state; its value is never echoed to the page, and the copy is a constant. The remaining gap — a freelancer who hits a real Stripe failure sees a text/plain 502 instead of that URL — is ALREADY FILED as AS-69, which carries a depends_on edge to AS-45 and should be re-pointed at this task.

--- AS-45 plan §3.6, verbatim ---

Reachability, in three categories.

1 — Reachable in the offline suite (`docker compose run --rm test`, network_mode: none, no accounts, no egress). Every rendered state of both screens, every redirect-answered state, both n/a assertions: 7 of screen 1's 8 rows and 8 of screen 2's 9. Screen 2's Stripe-derived states are reachable offline because the screen renders the stored row — the suite seeds connected_accounts through deps.repos (which withServer hands the test) and calls updateReadiness with a fabricated snapshot, which is precisely the shape AS-41's own tests already use.

2 — Needs stripe-mock (`docker compose run --rm contract`). Nothing new. The behaviour behind S2-LOADING and S2-REFRESH — that POST /connect-stripe/start and GET /connect-stripe/refresh really redirect to a Stripe-issued URL with a request shape Stripe's own validator accepts — is already covered by AS-38's and AS-41's cases. This task adds no stripe-mock case and must not duplicate one. The one thing to verify here is negative and cheap: the contract service still passes with these screens in the image.

3 — Not exercisable offline, and named rather than silently untested. S1-LOADING and S2-LOADING are not implemented, and cannot be, under the standing no-client-side-JavaScript assumption. "Fields disabled, button reads Signing in…" is a state a page enters after its bytes were served; producing it requires JavaScript on submit. With no JavaScript, the interval between submit and the server's 303 is the browser's own loading indicator, and this app emits no bytes during it. Verified that the assumption still holds (P2c: zero script elements in the tree) and these screens do not change it. The rows are marked in the test's committed table as `unrenderable — browser-supplied`, so their absence is an assertion rather than a gap. The real hosted round trip — a genuine Stripe account moving not-ready -> ready through return_url — belongs to the acceptance run (AS-50), as the VERIFICATION clause says. Offline, the transition is exercised by seeding both sides of it; the hosted flow is not. Visual judgment at 375px is the third: the implementer runs docker compose up, opens screen 2 at a 375px viewport in every state that renders, and records in a Lattice comment the viewport used, each state observed, each state NOT observed, and any state where text overflowed, wrapped badly, or a control fell off.

--- AS-45 plan ACs 12-14, verbatim ---

12. Screen 2: all 9 ledger rows accounted for — the 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 9 partition of §3.5.2 asserted as arithmetic against a committed table.
13. S2-RETURN-NOTREADY is exercised through both halves of `ready`: `chargesEnabled: false`, and `chargesEnabled: true` with a non-empty `requirementsCurrentlyDue`.
14. S2-ERROR-SYSTEM renders at `GET /connect-stripe?error=start`, and the parameter's value appears nowhere in the response body.

--- THE MONEY-WORD LANDMINE (AS-45 plan §5), read this before writing a line of the template ---

02-states-ledger.md §2's copy for S2-DEFAULT-NOTSTARTED reads: "We never hold or move your clients' MONEY — Stripe pays you directly." The 'money representation' concept row scans RAW text, comments included, with /amount|currency|money/i, and its allowlist is seven files, none of them a view. Putting that sentence in views/connect-stripe.ejs turns the suite red. DO NOT add the view to the allowlist — the row exists to confine money representation to the files that handle integer minor units. DO NOT narrow the pattern. Reword to "funds": 00-flows.md Flow 2 step 1 already uses exactly that word for exactly this sentence, so the flow's own wording is the fix, not an invention. The sentence becomes: "We never hold or move your clients' funds — Stripe pays you directly." Watch the same three words in app.css comments and in the view model. Measured 2026-09-03: `grep -oiE 'amount|currency|money' apps/invoicing/views/*.ejs apps/invoicing/public/*.css | wc -l` is 0 today and must stay 0.

--- FALSIFICATION RECIPES STILL OWED (AS-45 plan §7 F7 and F11) ---

Every other recipe in the AS-45 plan (F1-F6, F8-F10, F12) was run under AS-45 and is recorded in its Lattice comment. These two are screen-2-specific and are this task's to run, under the house mutation discipline: mutate a `git archive HEAD` extract OUTSIDE the worktree, assert the mutation applied on disk AND inside the built image with an occurrence-accurate count (`grep -oF ... | wc -l`, never `grep -c`), record predicted vs observed failing sets and classify every divergence, prove restoration, rebuild and re-run. Use an isolated compose project (`-p <name>`); never touch asc-invoicing-web-1 (8348) or asc-chat-server-1 (8347).

F7 — an existing guard fires, in the direction it exists to catch (the live hazard on this task). Pre-measured baseline: `grep -oiE 'amount|currency|money' docs/design/wireframes/screen-2-connect-stripe.html | wc -l` = 1 (line 58, the copy). Mutation: change "funds" back to "money" in views/connect-stripe.ejs. Assert applied: `grep -oiF money views/connect-stripe.ejs | wc -l` = 1. Predicted failing set: one case, the concept-row case, with the 'money representation' row reporting views/connect-stripe.ejs as an unexpected member.

F11 — the state table is not decorative. Mutation: delete the S2-RETURN-NOTREADY branch from views/connect-stripe.ejs. Assert applied: `grep -oF 'S2-RETURN-NOTREADY' views/connect-stripe.ejs | wc -l` = 0 after a non-zero baseline (measure the baseline first). Predicted failing set, at least three cases: the two S2-RETURN-NOTREADY HTTP cases (both halves of `ready`, AC 13) and the partition-arithmetic case "screen 2's nine ledger rows partition 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1". Fewer than three means a state is being asserted by only one path.

--- HOUSEKEEPING THIS TASK INHERITS ---

lib/connect/onboarding.js's SCREEN_PATH comment and apps/invoicing/README.md now name THIS task as the one that lands `GET /connect-stripe` (AS-45 re-pointed them when it split). Both must be corrected again when this lands, and the README's § Obligations line about screen 2 removed. That comment is the ONE edit permitted to lib/connect/onboarding.js: a comment, no code.

PLAN WRITTEN (cto-owen, 2026-09-12, on Opus under the Fable fallback). Plan: .lattice/plans/task_01M1JE53S29MRXYYXXGGKGP2RN.md, below the description. Branch feat/AS-70-connect-screen from master d611fd7, worktree .worktrees/AS-70. Implementer developer-marcus; reviewer qa-ruben. Complexity medium, three stages.

BASELINE, measured this tick from isolated project asc-plan-as70 with --build: test 405 tests / 387 pass / 0 fail / 18 skipped, receipt 'Image asc-plan-as70-test Built', exit 0 (log scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-70/baseline-test.log; project torn down --rmi local; shared containers untouched). PREDICTED after implementation: 418 / 400 / 0 / 18 — 13 new cases in screens.test.js, every title named in the plan.

CARDINALITY LITERALS re-verified against master today: none moved since the description was written. auth.test.js 17/16/11-entry list/11 (G3) — and the description's fourth '17' is G15, not a second G1 literal; health VIEWS 1 and ['signin.ejs']; dependency-policy source 50; VIEW_START_TAGS 87 (the description omits it; it moves by the new template's tag count, measured post-write). All written as recounts at rebase time, never copied.

KEY DECISIONS. (1) The view model takes the row and a boolean: the route computes req.query.error === 'start' and the query value never enters the view model, so AC 14's 'value appears nowhere in the body' is structural; the error flag takes precedence over the row, with the reason recorded. ready is read from the repository row, never re-derived (falsifier planted). (2) S2-RETURN-READY ships WITHOUT 'Continue to Dashboard': the Dashboard is AS-48's and a control pointing at a route nothing serves is the R-2 defect one screen later; asserted (zero forms, zero anchors on READY), hand-off to AS-48 recorded. (3) GET / becomes 303 /connect-stripe as AS-45's R-2 promised; the six cases routes/pages.js names are rewritten in place (one retitle), hop count 2, terminus asserted on the S2-DEFAULT-NOTSTARTED sentinel. (4) Template branches on banner tone with constant class names, never on state ids or an interpolated class; F11 is re-targeted to deleting the banner-warning branch and predicts FOUR reds (the two NOTREADY halves, the partition case, and the concept-row case on VIEW_START_TAGS) — the fourth named before the run. (5) B5 lands: scanConcept's only: rows and P4 get committed file counts (3 and 2); B4 stays deferred with its stale 'AS-70's' trigger corrected. (6) The money word: 'funds', per 00-flows.md; zero money-words measured today across views/, public/, lib/screens/, views.js, routes/connect.js, routes/pages.js.

LIVE TRAP: test/auth.test.js measures 1199 lines by the 1,200-ceiling test's own instrument. The two route entries alone would cross it; removing INTERIM_LANDING_BODY and its comment pays for them (net -2 → 1197). AS-46 has no such removals and WILL cross it — the plan recommends extracting the route-surface block into test/route-surface.test.js as AS-46's honest fix, not comment trimming.

GRAPH CORRECTED: AS-70 depended on AS-71 (backlog) — an advisory edge I wrote on 09-03, inverted now: AS-71 depends on AS-70. The S2-ABANDON ledger amendment (AS-45 plan §9 Q3) folds into AS-71's plan rather than becoming a task.

SEAMS. AS-90 (in review): no scope overlap — the demo drives readiness via a synthesized signed account.updated webhook, not the screen; shared files are dependency-policy.test.js (different hunks) and README.md (different regions); one sentence of demo prose about the /connect-stripe dangle goes stale after this merges. AS-46 (planning in parallel): same literals, same test files; proposed merge order AS-90 → AS-70 → AS-46, second screen lane rebases and recounts before review.

Owed to the implementer beyond the code: F7, F11, F11-b, F18–F23, F12 at both ends, all with on-disk AND in-image assert-applied counts; the 375px inspection with the viewport MEASURED (headless Chrome clamps --window-size to 500 and crops — AS-45's near-false-defect); contract suite once at the end.

IMPLEMENTED (developer-marcus, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 4; running on Opus under the Fable-usage fallback). Branch feat/AS-70-connect-screen, tip 4e33d69, two commits on top of the plan commit d611fd7 — d5daf5d (view model, template, GET /connect-stripe, VIEWS row) and 4e33d69 (GET / -> 303 /connect-stripe, the six cases, screen 2's thirteen cases, every literal recounted, onboarding comment, README). Diff touches exactly the plan §2 list: 2 created + 9 modified, 11 files, 842/152. Zero .lattice paths; `git diff master...HEAD -- apps/invoicing/public` and `-- apps/invoicing/test/connect.test.js` both empty (AC 22, AC 25). Commits as developer-marcus in the actor-id form. Scratchpad: scratchpad/developer-marcus/AS-70/ (run logs, mutant logs, visual PNGs, the harness scripts); progress note scratchpad/developer-marcus/AS-70-progress.md. RECEIPTS (cardinality first). Offline: `docker compose -p asc-inv-as70-test run --build --rm test` -> `Image asc-inv-as70-test-test Built`, exit 0, 418 tests / 400 pass / 0 fail / 18 skipped — exactly the plan §0.1 prediction (405 + 13 new cases, none removed, no new file). Re-run on the final tree after every recipe: same image line, same 418/400/0/18. Contract: `-p asc-inv-as70-contract run --build --rm contract` -> `Image asc-inv-as70-contract-contract Built`, exit 0, 418 / 418 / 0 / 0 — no stripe-mock case added or modified (AC 24). F12 both ends: `-e ASC_SELFTEST_MUTATE=1 test` on a rebuilt image exit 1 with exactly V1 red (418/399/1) at the start and again at the end; plain test exit 0 between and after. All 13 named case titles verbatim, all ran green; the six rewritten cases ran green under their (one retitled) names. LITERALS, recounted not copied (§0.2): ALL_ROUTES 18 ('GET /connect-stripe' sorts before 'GET /connect-stripe/refresh'); G1 18; G1b 17; G2's protected list 12 members; G3 12; G15 18; PUBLIC_ROUTES 6 unchanged; VIEWS 2, ['signin.ejs', 'connect-stripe.ejs'] in declaration order; app-source 52 (+ lib/screens/connect-view.js, + views/connect-stripe.ejs, sorted into the list); VIEW_START_TAGS = 87 + 43 = 130 — connect-stripe.ejs measured 43 by the perl-style strip-and-count, 42 by `grep -oE '`), failing set collected from the runner's own ✖ lines, PREDICTION WRITTEN INTO THE HARNESS BEFORE THE RUN (scratchpad/developer-marcus/AS-70/mutants.mjs; per-recipe logs with the mutated diff in AS-70/mut/): - F7 (view model lede 'funds' -> 'money'; disk 0->1, image 1): predicted 1, observed 1 — the concept-row case, `money representation: found in […, lib/screens/connect-view.js, …]`. Case 4 stayed green. RE-TARGETED from the plan's wording: §7 F7 says mutate views/connect-stripe.ejs, but §3.2/§3.3 put the copy in the view model and the template holds no sentence to mutate. So I ran the template direction too: - F7-t (the word planted in a template comment; disk 0->1, image 1): predicted 1, observed 1 — the same row naming views/connect-stripe.ejs. The row scans raw text over both new files. - F11 (delete the `banner.tone === 'warning'` block; `banner-warning` 1->0 disk and image): predicted 4, observed 4 — both NOTREADY HTTP cases, the partition case (`"banner-warning" occurs 0 time(s) … expected exactly 1`), and the concept-row case on `P4 examined 126 start tags across 2 template(s), expected 130`. - F11-b (S2-REFRESH disposition -> 'rendered'; marker 0->1): plan predicted 3; I PREDICTED 5 before running, observed 5 — the plan's three (set-inequality case, partition, 'S2-REFRESH and S2-LOADING never render this screen') plus case 7 and case 13, each of which asserts the set of states it observed over HTTP equals CONNECT_STATES, which the mutation grows to five. Divergence classified: my cases are stricter than the plan's prediction, in the direction of coverage; not a weakness. - F18 (pages.js -> '/nope'; 0->1): predicted 6, observed 6 — exactly the six of §3.5, no more (G15 and the cookieless-guard case are answered by the guard and stayed green). - F19 (async handler + `try { await onboarding.handleRefresh(...) } catch {}` before the render; `handleRefresh(` 1->2 in routes/connect.js): predicted 1, observed 1 — case 7, `the screen made 2 Stripe transport call(s)` (one per GET on the not-ready row; the catch swallowed both and the render proceeded, which is why the transport counts rather than the status). - F20 (`=== true` -> `Boolean(...)`, route intact; 0->1): predicted 1, observed 1 — case 3, `account=null startFailed="start" rendered S2-ERROR-SYSTEM`. Case 8 stayed green because the route's `=== 'start'` is intact — this recipe proves the view model's own edge, as the plan says. - F21 (P2b's only -> /^views\// with expectFiles 3; the `/^(views|public)\//` literal 4->3 disk and image): predicted 1, observed 1 — the concept-row case, `event-handler attribute: examined 2 files, expected 3`. DIRECTION TWO on a master extract with the same narrowing against the old `> 0` floor: predicted 0, observed 0 — 405/387/0/18 green, `Image asc-as70-f21-master-test Built`. The recipe measures the fix. - F22 (`account.ready === true` -> re-derivation from chargesEnabled/requirementsCurrentlyDue; marker 0->1 in lib/screens/): plan predicted 1; I PREDICTED 2 before running, observed 2 — case 6's unit half, and case 3, whose committed rows are bare `{ ready: true }` objects with no inputs to re-derive from, so the re-derivation renders NOTREADY for them. Classified: the plan's own case-3 shape makes it a second detector of the same defect. - F23 (`Continue to Dashboard` planted in the success branch; needle 0->1): predicted 2, observed 2 — case 6 (`READY renders no anchor`) and the concept-row case (`132 … expected 130`). P2a green — a constant href is not an interpolation; AC 9 polices the control. NOTE ON THE NEEDLE: the plan's marker was the phrase 'Continue to Dashboard', which the template's header comment already contains once (it explains why READY has no control); my first baseline check refused at 1 ≠ 0, so the needle is the planted element itself. The rendered-body assertion in case 6 is unaffected (EJS comments do not render; the suite is green). Survivors: none. Worktree proven clean after the battery (`git diff --exit-code`), and the final receipts above are from a rebuilt image. 375px INSPECTION (AC 28, §9). Instrument: the branch's web service in `-p asc-as70-visual` on 127.0.0.1:8358 (`run --build --rm --no-deps -d -p 127.0.0.1:8358:8348 web`, own volume), sign-up over HTTP, the two Stripe-derived rows seeded by a one-off `run --rm --no-deps web node -e` in the same project (create + updateReadiness with all six keys: not-ready = chargesEnabled false + ['external_account']; ready = true + []), headless Chrome 152.0.7977.83 driven over CDP with `Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride({ width: 375, height: 812, mobile: true })` — never --window-size. VIEWPORT MEASURED through the DOM on every page: innerWidth 375, documentElement.clientWidth 375, scrollWidth 375 on all four states in BOTH schemes (`Emulation.setEmulatedMedia` prefers-color-scheme light and dark, each confirmed via matchMedia). Elements whose box crosses 0 or 375: none, on any state. Widest text block 343px (the container's inner width). Controls, all inside the viewport: "Connect with Stripe" x 16..200, "Try again" x 16..120, "Finish setup on Stripe" x 16..214; READY has none, by design. States LOOKED AT (eight PNGs in scratchpad/developer-marcus/AS-70/visual/, four of them read by me): NOTSTARTED, ERROR-SYSTEM, RETURN-NOTREADY, RETURN-READY, light and dark. Overflow: none. Bad wraps: none — the two-line titles on NOTSTARTED and NOTREADY break at a word. Controls falling off: none. States NOT looked at: S2-LOADING (unrenderable), S2-REFRESH and S2-DENIED-SIGNEDOUT (redirect-answered, no pixels of their own), S2-ABANDON (a path into NOTREADY, which was looked at), S2-EMPTY (n/a). Also observed in the same browser session: GET / landed on /connect-stripe in state S2-RETURN-READY. Torn down with `down -v --rmi local`; the `run -d` container and the contract project's stripe-mock survived their downs (compose `down` does not see profile services without --profile tools) and were removed by name afterwards; every asc-as70-* / asc-inv-as70-* image, volume, network and container is gone. `asc-plan-as70-test` (Owen's planning image, same profile reason) is still on the host — his to remove. asc-invoicing-web-1 / asc-chat-server-1 were never touched. DEVIATIONS AND OPEN ITEMS, for Ruben: 1. Case 4 asserts the lede by the halves around the substituted noun (`We never hold or move your clients' ` and ` — Stripe pays you directly.`), not on the word 'funds'. AC 4 says "with the word funds"; F7 says case 4 must stay green when the money row goes red, and both cannot hold if the case asserts the noun. I kept F7's rule: the noun is the concept row's claim (AC 21), and the case proves the sentence is on the page. 2. One retitle beyond the plan's single allowed one: health.test.js 'there is exactly one registered view' -> 'there are exactly two registered views'. The old title encodes the number the case asserts; keeping it would have been a false title. §5 says titles do not move — flagging it as the one exception, veto if you disagree. 3. AC 27's grep: `until AS-70` and `AS-70 restores` return zero hits; the third pattern `404s until` hits README.md:736, which is AS-47's contract-detail dangle ("/contracts/, which 404s until AS-47 lands the screens") — true, not this task's, and not in the three README regions §2 names, so I left it. The AS-48 hand-off (READY's control, `/`, POST_SIGNIN_LANDING) is stated once in § Obligations. 4. auth.test.js at 1198, not 1197 (above). 5. lib/connect/onboarding.js hunk, comment only (AC 26): lines 20-25, the SCREEN_PATH docstring — "Screen 2's route. It still dangles (404): AS-45 landed the view layer and screen 1 and then split on its own pre-agreed line, so screen 2 is AS-70. Deliberate, as before — the Location header is the contract, and if AS-70 renames the screen this constant plus its test assertions are the whole diff (AS-41 plan §9 Q2)." -> "Screen 2's route, served by routes/connect.js's `GET /connect-stripe` (AS-70) as a pure function of the stored row. Every redirect this module issues to the screen lands on a rendered state: READY after a return that found requirements met, NOTREADY otherwise. The Location header is the contract, and if the screen is ever renamed this constant plus its test assertions are the whole diff (AS-41 plan §9 Q2)." Also corrected: routes/connect.js's file header (it named AS-45 as screen 2's owner) — a comment, in a file §2 already lists as modified. 6.
